# teams_online_pstn_gateway (Resource)

Manages the OnlinePSTNGateway policy via New-CsOnlinePSTNGateway / Get-CsOnlinePSTNGateway / Set-CsOnlinePSTNGateway / Remove-CsOnlinePSTNGateway.
